verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages say it automatically and instantly provisions and revokes accounts and group access through dynamic rules, updates permissions and groups on role changes, and supports custom SCIM apps. That covers the core of push-based provisioning of users, groups and access levels. missing for 10: in-depth SCIM provisioning documentation (attribute or entitlement mapping, per-app connector details), explicit evidence of entitlement push beyond 'access level/permissions', independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time downstream sync.
